chapter: Ella, Charlie Christian and Europe with Hayes
title: T-Bone Walker, Oklahoma City and Charlie's brother
summary: Dance recalls T-Bone and Charlie learning chords in Oklahoma City and asks if Charlie's brother also had tuberculosis; Clarke cannot say.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Didn't -- it seemed to me, you know -- T-Bone told me, because they -- T-Bone was in Dallas and Charlie was in Oklahoma City --
Uh-huh.

And you know -- and T-Bone was in a local band there and Charlie took his place in the band. You know the band, but it slipped my mind. A territory band out there, you know, and it became -- well, it's slipped my mind. Tomorrow I'll tell you.
Uh-huh.
But anyway, it seemed to me that they both learned chords from the same guy in Oklahoma City. This was when they were both coming up.
Yeah. Yeah.
It seemed to me that he -- I thought he said that his brother had TB, too.
It.
I thought he said that Charlie had a brother.
Yeah, a bass player.
Is that so?
Yeah, It. His name was It. [Buddy Christian]
And did he die?
I don't know whether It is dead or not.
But did he have tuberculosis too?
I couldn't say that either. Because I met his mother when she came to New York.
Oh.
And she never said anything about It. It was never sick.
Oh, well, then maybe I'm wrong on that. Even he could have been wrong on that.
Yeah.
